notablePrerequisites:
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling another card from your graveyard for each opponent you have, giving Vizier of Tumbling Sands encore until end of turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' encore ability by paying {2}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Activate a Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, targeting another Vizier of Tumbling Sands token.
The Vizier of Tumbling Sands token triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token.
Repeat from step 3.
